lines.zh: 我贴着浅滩的沙底巡过去。
lines.en: I patrol low over the sandy shallows.

lines.zh: 我的身体长，转弯要慢一点。
lines.en: My body is long, so I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我摆尾三次就窜出很远。
lines.en: Three tail beats carry me a long way.

lines.zh: 温水让我游得比谁都稳。
lines.en: Warm water makes my swimming steadier than anyone's.
I travel along the edge of the seagrass.
There is a school of fish on the flat ahead.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把鳍收起来。
lines.en: I flatten down and fold my fins in.
I pass the reef and my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 暖水里的鱼都在我牙下。
lines.en: Every warm-water fish is under my teeth.
I can swim against the warm current too.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在外面，合不上。
lines.en: My teeth stick out and will not close over them.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块珊瑚走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that coral head once.

lines.zh: 水浅了，背鳍划出一道痕。
lines.en: The water shallows and my dorsal fin leaves a line.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可从不回头。
lines.en: I do not swim fast, but I never look back.

lines.zh: 我从礁缝里钻出去，鳞片擦了一下。
lines.en: I squeeze out of the crevice, scales scraping.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖流边缘游，水色变浅。
lines.en: I follow the warm current's edge into paler water.

lines.zh: 我跟在那群小鱼后面，不着急。
lines.en: I trail the small school without hurrying.

lines.zh: 我一摆头，海草的影子就断了。
lines.en: One turn of my head breaks the seagrass shadow.

lines.zh: 我悬在浅水里，一动也不动。
lines.en: I hang in the shallows without moving.
My long shadow lies on the sandy bottom.

lines.zh: 我在等一条鱼游错方向。
lines.en: I wait for a fish to swim the wrong way.
The warm water makes me lazy.
I open and close my mouth slowly, changing water.
The swell pushes, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我盯着海草里的小动静。
lines.en: I watch for small movements in the seagrass.

lines.zh: 这条水道今天没什么吃的。
lines.en: There is little to eat in this channel today.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让光打在鳞上。
lines.en: I turn so the light falls on my scales.
I hear oars somewhere far off.
I hide myself in the reef's shadow.
My tail sways gently.

lines.zh: 水面上的云走得比我快。
lines.en: The clouds above travel faster than I do.
Whoever comes near, I know it.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，我盯着你的腿。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows and I watch your legs.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，水纹传到我这边。
lines.en: You bend down and the ripples reach me.

lines.zh: 我的眼在头两侧，都看着你。
lines.en: My eyes are on both sides, and both watch you.

lines.zh: 你在岸上，我在水下半臂。
lines.en: You are on land; I am half an arm underwater.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就前进半步。
lines.en: You step back one pace and I advance half.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在沙上，我绕开。
lines.en: Your shadow lands on the sand and I go around it.
I know I make you uneasy.
The fish in your hand is still dripping blood.
In the warm shallows, I know the smell of blood.
I've been trailing you through the warm water.
A scale was knocked off me.
I flick my tail and back into the reef.
That struck near my gills and it hurts.
Blood trails away in a thin line.
I turn around, ready to bite back.
Do not assume I will flee.
I bit empty air and hit the stone.

lines.zh: 身上开了口子，我在渗血。
lines.en: There is a gash in me and I am bleeding.

lines.zh: 我慢下来了，可还盯着你。
lines.en: I have slowed, but I am still watching you.
My gills still move, but slowly.

lines.zh: 温水里的小鱼都归我追。
lines.en: Every small fish in warm water is mine to chase.

lines.zh: 死鱼的味道在水里散开。
lines.en: The smell of dead fish spreads through the water.
I am not picky; anything edible will do.

lines.zh: 你把饵扔下来，我看见了。
lines.en: You drop bait and I see it.
The smell of blood makes my gums itch.
That chunk of meat is not far below the surface.

lines.zh: 我绕着你手里的鱼转圈。
lines.en: I circle the fish in your hand.
Wave it twice and I will come up.

lines.zh: 我吃过比这更小的东西。
lines.en: I have eaten things much smaller than that.
Lower it a bit more and I will bite.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的身侧，滑得很。
lines.en: You hit my flank and it is slippery.
I brushed past your legs just now.
Make room in the water; I am longer than you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的尾巴，我甩开。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail and I flicked free.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，谁都没停。
lines.en: We knocked once and neither of us stopped.

lines.zh: 别贴着礁壁，我会挤过去。
lines.en: Do not hug the reef wall; I will squeeze past.
My scales scraped your calf.
That knock threw me off course.
I pull aside and let you through.
After the bump I circle you once.
In the warm water we swim side by side.
I press my flank against hers.
We circle around the seagrass clump.
She is smaller than me but swims faster.

lines.zh: 我们不叫，只用身体说话。
lines.en: We make no sound; we speak with our bodies.
The eggs will scatter over the shallow sand.
Afterwards we each go our own way.
Her scales shine in the light.
I followed her across a whole shallow flat.

lines.zh: 水里两条长影子并在一起。
lines.en: Two long shadows in the water join as one.

lines.zh: 那块肉沉到沙上，我去捡。
lines.en: That meat sank to the sand, so I go get it.

lines.zh: 我绕开铁器，肉才值得捡。
lines.en: I steer around iron; only meat is worth taking.
I take every scrap of dead fish.

lines.zh: 你掉进水里的东西，我看看。
lines.en: Let me see what you dropped in the water.
I bite it and drag it into a crevice.
This piece is too big for me to swallow.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里走一段。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth for a while.

lines.zh: 掉下来的碎屑也是食物。
lines.en: The crumbs that fall are food too.
I take it and leave without lingering.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我抢先一步。
lines.en: You reach for it, and I get there first.
A school of small fish mills over the shallows.
I spot a fish that has fallen behind.

lines.zh: 水面一乱，我就从下面上去
lines.en: The surface breaks; I come up from below.

lines.zh: 我把方向对准了那片沙。
lines.en: I aim myself at that stretch of sand.

lines.zh: 一个影子游进了我的水域。
lines.en: A shadow swims into my territory.
I pick out the one swimming slowly.
Its tail is missing a piece.
I have chosen; that one is mine.
The target is behind the reef.
I start moving that way.
I flatten down with my fins tight to my body.
I circle it, looking for an angle.
It has not noticed me yet.
I shorten the distance bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把獠牙给对方看
lines.en: I turn broadside so it sees my fangs.

lines.zh: 等它离礁石远一点再动。
lines.en: I wait for it to move away from the reef.
I approach from behind.

lines.zh: 水纹会暴露我，我停一下。
lines.en: The ripples would give me away, so I pause.
I fix my eyes on its gills.
Three arms more and I charge.
I bite into its flank.

lines.zh: 我的牙向后倒，它挣不脱。
lines.en: My teeth lean backward and it cannot pull free.
The water turns red at once.
My teeth clamp down and scales scatter.
It rams me and I bite down harder.

lines.zh: 这一口我只用了五分力。
lines.en: That bite used only half my strength.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进深一点的缝。
lines.en: I drag it into a deeper crevice.
After biting I retreat half a metre.

lines.zh: 我不追逃得太远的东西。
lines.en: I do not chase what flees too far.
Scales are still stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，我落进温水。
lines.en: The spawn egg cracks and I drop into warm water.
I open my eyes already on the shallows.
This seagrass bed is good cover.
I was born to swim alone.
The water is warm and I stretch out.

lines.zh: 我先绕着自己的影子转。
lines.en: First I circle my own shadow.

lines.zh: 附近没有鲨鱼，运气不错。
lines.en: No sharks nearby; lucky me.

lines.zh: 我刚出现就开始找吃的。
lines.en: I start hunting the moment I appear.

lines.zh: 沙上留着我落下的痕迹。
lines.en: The sand bears the mark of my landing.

lines.zh: 是谁把我放进这片水的。
lines.en: Who put me into this water?

lines.zh: 热水从上面浇下来，我乱窜。
lines.en: Hot water pours down from above and I thrash.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，摔在礁石上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water onto the reef.

lines.zh: 我离了水，鳃只能贴着空气。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills press against air.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我推得翻过来。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over in the water.
An arrow is lodged in my back.
That flash leaves me rigid all over.

lines.zh: 我饿得连小鱼都追不上。
lines.en: I am so hungry I cannot catch small fish.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅滩，我浑身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and I convulse.

lines.zh: 海里忽然空了，我往下坠
lines.en: The sea suddenly empties; I fall.
